clues: This city sits in the north-east of its land, on a wide lake. A canal links the lake to the sea and its port.
This city has hot, dry days for much of the year. Its summers are long, and its winters are mild, with some rain.
Long ago, this city was the chief town of a strong realm. Its lands stretched out towards Tripoli and Fez.
The old heart of this city is a famed world gem. UNESCO has kept it on its World Heritage list since 1979.
This is the largest city in the whole land, and its seat of rule. All the top chiefs of the state work here.
